facts.fact: 感恩节：离异父母仍好友，全家在明尼苏达团聚
facts.anchor: Even though our parents had divorced a few years ago, they remained good friends.

facts.fact: 家训 Hockey first：父母清晨送训、打额外工付装备
facts.anchor: Hockey first had been our family motto for as long as I could remember.

facts.fact: 父母为兄妹俩维持婚姻，双双打上职业后才离婚
facts.anchor: My parents had stayed together for my brother and me, only divorcing after we’d both gone pro.

facts.fact: Brightside 谈崩放弃；Levi 愿意牺牲薪水挺她，她更愧疚
facts.anchor: In the end, we’d passed on the deal with Brightside Sunglasses.

facts.fact: 她强行断联 Carson 一周就破功
facts.anchor: I’d made it a week before I’d caved.

facts.fact: 大新闻：联盟成立顾问委员会，Logan 受邀加入
facts.anchor: They want to consult people who have typically been underrepresented in the sport—minorities, those in the LGBTQIA+ community, and women. And they asked me to be part of it.

facts.fact: 功劳归 Carson 但不能说，谎称听众转达

facts.fact: 妈妈：外公Joe打过Bruins；她大学打球却因性别无缘职业
